context:
Goal: nothing moves under your finger, on any phone width.
Problem (rule): at 320 px wide the Tally card moves 14 px under your finger when you check in, which breaks your rule that nothing moves under a tap, and the fix changes the card's look.
Based on (measured): the pictures drawn from the built card at 320 px, which show the 14 px move on check-ins 1 and 6.
Based on (read): the record of this known gap, which says three buttons where the card has two bulk buttons.
Departs from: main lets the Tally card's buttons come and go — option a reserves room for both bulk buttons and hides the one that does not apply.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the coordinator acts on your pick next.

lastAnswer.note: Owner: 320 px is not a real phone width; closed, no change.

options.gain: Nothing moves under your finger at any width.
options.how: Every Tally card holds room for both bulk buttons and hides the one that does not apply, then the screens check adds 320 px.
options.label: Keep both buttons in place
options.lose: The card is 14 px taller at rest at 320 px, a blank slot where the hidden button sits (measured on a copy with the hidden button added, not built code).

options.how: No change; the debt records 320 px as a known gap.
options.label: Accept the move at 320 px
options.lose: On the narrowest phones a tap can land on the wrong button: the rows move 14 px on check-in 1 and back on check-in 6 at 320 px (measured on the built page).

options.gain: Nothing moves and there is no blank slot.
options.how: The two bulk buttons get shorter words, so they sit on one line at 320 px and nothing moves.
options.label: Shorten the button labels so both fit on one line
options.lose: The button words change. Not drawn yet; the designer put the saving at about 20 px, an estimate, not measured.

ref: debt tally-card-moves-at-320px (the Tally card moves at 320px); invariant no-layout-shift-under-pointer; decision card-reserved-geometry
reply: Short answer: never on a current iPhone. Repo decision card-the-action-row-is-reserved says 320 px is below the app's stated 380 px floor and is not a width current iOS runs; the 14 px move at 320 was left on purpose. So this question asked about a width your phone does not have, and I should not have put it to you. Your answer, none of these, stands as: do nothing. Closed; the open gap on main (debt tally-card-moves-at-320px) goes to the coordinator to retire. Your own phone's real width is still the open question on item 109. 19:56 CST 2026-11-21.

shown.label: Keep all three buttons in place
Shorten the button labels so both fit on one line

title: At a 320 px screen, the Tally card jumps 14 px when you check in. Fix it, though the look changes?
why: The no-shift rule is one of the eight that must not break, and a mis-tap there checks in the wrong card.
